how.title: From tech pack to delivery in three steps

request.title: Request a quote
request.body: Share your tech pack, quantities and target price. We route it to factories that fit your product and certifications.

compare.title: Compare and confirm
compare.body: Review anonymised offers side by side, approve samples, and pay a deposit into escrow when you’re ready.

track.title: Track to your door
track.body: Follow every milestone with photos, independent QC reports and shipping documents, all in one place.

trust.title: Built so you never have to take a factory’s word for it

verified.title: Verified factories
verified.body: Every manufacturer passes business and export checks, and their BSCI, WRAP, GOTS or OEKO-TEX certificates are verified before they can quote.

escrow.title: Escrow-protected payments
escrow.body: You pay GarmentGate, not the factory. Funds are released in stages as production milestones are approved.

qc.title: Independent QC inspection
qc.body: AQL inspections during and after production. Nothing ships until it passes, and you get the full report.

categories.title: Whatever you make, there’s a factory for it

cta.title: Ready to source with confidence?
cta.body: Create a free account in a minute. Our team will help you place your first order.

footer.tagline: Managed garment sourcing between global buyers and verified factories.

profile.title: Factory profile
profile.description: What buyers see when they find you, under your factory code only.

photos.title: Factory photos
photos.description: Show your floor, machines and finishing. Every photo is stripped of location and camera data, then checked by our team before buyers see it. Avoid signage, logos and faces.
photos.max: Up to {max} photos, JPG, PNG or WebP up to 15 MB each.

certs.description: New certificates are verified by our team. Buyers see the standard you hold and its validity, never the certificate number.
certs.emptyBody: Add BSCI, WRAP, GOTS, OEKO-TEX or others to win buyers who require them.

preview.title: This is exactly what buyers see
preview.body: Generated by the same code that serves buyers. Your company name, address, website, contacts and certificate numbers are never included, and are removed from your own text too.

DEPOSIT_PENDING.title: Confirm the order?
DEPOSIT_PENDING.body: Your purchase order is issued and the deposit becomes due.

IN_PRODUCTION.title: Start production?
IN_PRODUCTION.body: Confirm the deposit has arrived (or resume production).

QC.title: Ready for inspection?
QC.body: All stages are complete and the goods are ready to inspect.

READY_TO_SHIP.title: Inspection passed?
READY_TO_SHIP.body: The goods passed inspection and can ship.

SHIPPED.title: Mark as shipped
SHIPPED.body: Add how the goods travel and the tracking number.

COMPLETED.title: Complete the order?
COMPLETED.body: Everything arrived as agreed. The balance is released to the factory.

DISPUTED.title: Report a problem
DISPUTED.body: GarmentGate reviews the order with both sides. Tell us what went wrong.

CHOOSE_SAMPLING.title: Sample first, or go straight to production?
CHOOSE_SAMPLING.body: A sample lets you check fit, fabric and finish before bulk. Reorders of an approved style can skip it.

FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.title: Your sample is being made
FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.body: The factory ships it soon; you’ll get the tracking number here.

REVIEW_SAMPLE.title: Your sample has shipped: review it
REVIEW_SAMPLE.body: Approve it, or tell the factory what to change (photos help).

CONFIRM_ORDER.title: Sample approved: confirm the order
CONFIRM_ORDER.body: Confirming issues your purchase order; production starts once the deposit arrives.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Pay the {deposit} deposit
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Payment details are on your purchase order. Production starts as soon as it arrives.

PRODUCTION.title: In production: {stage}
PRODUCTION.body: Photos from the factory appear on each stage as it progresses.

INSPECTION.title: Quality inspection
INSPECTION.body: An inspector checks the goods against your approved sample.

SHIP.title: Getting ready to ship
SHIP.body: You’ll get the carrier and tracking number here.

IN_TRANSIT.title: On its way: {carrier} {tracking}
IN_TRANSIT.body: Confirm delivery when the goods arrive.

CONFIRM_COMPLETION.title: Delivered: is everything right?
CONFIRM_COMPLETION.body: Complete the order, or report a problem within 14 days.

RESOLVE_DISPUTE.title: We’re resolving your dispute
RESOLVE_DISPUTE.body: GarmentGate is working with the factory and will update you.

DONE.title: Order completed
DONE.body: Need more? Reorder the same style in a click.

CANCELLED.title: Order cancelled
CANCELLED.body: Message GarmentGate if you have questions.

CHOOSE_SAMPLING.title: Nothing to do right now
CHOOSE_SAMPLING.body: We’ll let you know when it’s your turn.

FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.title: Make and ship the sample
FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.body: Follow the brief, then add the courier and tracking number.

REVIEW_SAMPLE.title: The buyer is reviewing your sample
REVIEW_SAMPLE.body: You’ll hear as soon as they decide.

CONFIRM_ORDER.title: Sample approved
CONFIRM_ORDER.body: Waiting for the buyer to confirm the order.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Order confirmed
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Your purchase order is ready. Production starts when the deposit arrives.

PRODUCTION.title: Production: {stage}
PRODUCTION.body: Update each stage and add photos or videos: buyers love seeing progress.

SHIP.title: Inspection passed: ship it
SHIP.body: Add the carrier and tracking number when the goods leave.

CONFIRM_COMPLETION.title: Delivered
CONFIRM_COMPLETION.body: Waiting for the buyer to confirm.

CANCELLED.title: Order cancelled
CANCELLED.body: Message GarmentGate if you have questions.

CHOOSE_SAMPLING.title: Buyer to choose sampling
CHOOSE_SAMPLING.body: Draft order: the buyer requests a sample or confirms.

FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.title: Factory to ship the sample
FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.body: Chase the factory if it’s late.

REVIEW_SAMPLE.title: Buyer reviewing the sample
REVIEW_SAMPLE.body: Follow up if the buyer goes quiet.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Deposit pending
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Start production when the deposit is in.

PRODUCTION.title: In production
PRODUCTION.body: Review the factory’s photos in Moderation.

INSPECTION.title: Inspection
INSPECTION.body: Pass it (ready to ship) or send it back to production.

IN_TRANSIT.title: In transit
IN_TRANSIT.body: Confirm delivery if the buyer doesn’t.

CONFIRM_COMPLETION.title: Delivered
CONFIRM_COMPLETION.body: Waiting for the buyer to complete.

RESOLVE_DISPUTE.title: Resolve the dispute
RESOLVE_DISPUTE.body: Resume where it was, complete, or cancel.
